release.content: pubdoc 0.6.0 was released on 2026-11-26 from commit 1fcbe6d5e1aed0e021fa41c1774e82de7ccacc92 with these changes.

rows: A version publet's created is when it was approved (or $PUB_CREATED, which pins pub's dates too), not midnight of the doc's date: created is the signer's claim of when it signed. The doc's date stays in the identity claim's sentence and data row, and in versions.yml's approved

pubdoc corpus init rebuilds a restored key with pub 0.5: from the key object the corpus commits in objects/ with --expect alone, else with --created, the instant the key was made at (--key-created INSTANT, default pub 0.4's 2026-09-16T00:00:00Z), which pub 0.5 requires
A required part is required of a doc only when one of its layouts renders it: a doc whose doc.yml keeps only [cv-pdf, cv-linkedin] needs no letter, where check refused it

A doc.yml's templates gives a layout the doc keeps, one a template renders, another template for that doc alone: a template pubdoc carries, or a template directory of the repository by a path relative to the doc's directory; check holds it to project.yml's rules
pubdoc drives publet's pub 0.5 as well as 0.4, and its install hint names v0.5.0
